Class DefaultGameFactory

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.factory.DefaultGameFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameFactory
public class DefaultGameFactory extends Object implements GameFactory
Default singleton implementation of GameFactory.

The factory reuses the immutable DeckTemplate parsed at startup and creates a fully initialized Game with fresh decks, a new board, and turn-tracking components for each request. The game ID is always supplied by the caller (lobby ID) — the factory never generates IDs.
